answer: Bounty-backed liveness challenges: every agent locks a deposit as an anchor, and anyone who suspects two identities share one operator can post a bond to trigger a surprise test where both must solve distinct heavy tasks at the same moment. A real pair passes easily; one rig faking two agents stalls, and the challenger collects the forfeited deposits. Bonds make false accusations costly while payouts make sybil hunting profitable, so each fake works like a lantern in an ivory tower, drawing someone paid to expose it.
